original_context: Jennifer does not understand music theory.
Jennifer does not play by memory.
Anyone who understands music theory or has creative expression can produce beauty.
If Jennifer has a good ear, then she either harmonizes well or plays by memory (but not both).
Anyone who reads sheet music or harmonizes well can be an ensemble player.
Jennifer is either an ensemble player or a solo performer, but not both.
If Jennifer is an orchestra member, then she is either a solo performer or a classical musician, but not both.
If Jennifer is a classical musician, then she either possesses technical skill or has creative expression, but not both.
If Jennifer has either technical skill or musicality (but not both), then she is a virtuoso.
